name: Can I still file a claim if my spinal cord injury was partially my fault?

mainEntity.name: Can I still file a claim if my spinal cord injury was partially my fault?

acceptedAnswer.text: In California, you can generally still pursue a claim even if you were partially at fault for the incident that caused your spinal cord injury. California follows a system of 'pure comparative negligence,' meaning your compensation may be reduced by your percentage of fault. For example, if you are found 20% responsible, your award would be reduced by 20%. An experienced San Diego spinal cord injury lawyer can assess your specific situation and advise on how your partial fault might impact your claim.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, in California's pure comparative negligence system, you can file a claim even if partially at fault, though your compensation may be reduced accordingly.
